headline: Names a post office in Orange, California, after Specialist Trevor A. Win'E.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1075 North Tustin Street in Orange, California, as the "Specialist Trevor A. Win'E Post Office." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or any rules for mail.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 6, 2018, and the name took effect on that date.
